desc: Offline: port Gravity replacement/010-soc 91a96361b3 (rtkit crash-log copy GFP_NOIO; skip CSTS MMIO once ANS is dead; panic_on_crash param) as a kernel patch for the NVMe daily root (5005/5008), where an ANS crash under writeback can hang unreported. Relates to 201/3004 crashlog capture. See evidence/2026-10-29-gravitylinux-survey.md.
author: claude
progress_2026_10_29: Exported the public half as patches/t6040-rtkit-crashlog-gfp-noio.patch (Gravity 91a96361b3, author Niklas Sheth; rtkit.c GFP_KERNEL->GFP_NOIO, 3+/2-). Its commit message also describes the CSTS-skip in apple_nvme_disable/timeout and a panic_on_crash param, but those live in unpublished Gravity commit 4a0545d5 (GitHub 422); they must be written fresh against our asahi-wip nvme-apple.c. Not wired into t6040-kbuild.sh (explicit per-patch apply list), not built. Next: on the Mac host, git apply --check against wallace/t6040-bringup, add the kbuild stanza, then write the nvme half.
